method: BASELINE. Written straight from the deposited text with the writing-l4-rules skill, from the seat of the individual to whom the law is applied, with the design defaults ruled on 2026-10-18; no REFUSE; checked with the stable l4 of VS Code extension 1.6.98. No pipeline, no coverage table, no independent test pass, no human gate.
edition_encoded: Motor Vehicle and Workplace Accidents (Catastrophic Injuries) Act 2016 (WA), No. 8 of 2016, compilation with amendments to No. 21 of 2023 (in operation 1 July 2024), mrdoc 47531 retrieved 2026-09-07; Civil Liability Act 2002 s 13A as deposited (mrdoc 49335); Motor Vehicle (Third Party Insurance) Act 1943 ss 3EA, 3FB as deposited (mrdoc 47506); no regulations under the Act deposited
license: Apache-2.0 for the L4; the quoted statutory text is reproduced under CC BY 4.0 with the attribution in ../../SOURCE-LICENSE.md

checks.command: l4 run mvwaci-ciss.l4 ; l4 run mvwaci-cases-ciss.l4 ; l4 run mvwaci-qa.l4 ; l4 run mvwaci-qa-cases.l4 ; l4 check mvwaci-qa.l4
checks.result: 284 assertions satisfied (45 baseline + 239 Q&A layer), 0 errors, 0 warnings in all four files; l4 check mvwaci-qa.l4: Check succeeded (2026-11-06, after the qaf2 fix)
checks.note: l4 run exits 0 even when an assertion fails, so the diagnostics are what was read.

scope: ss 3(1), 4, 5, 5A, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15(3), 17, 18, 19, 24, 25, 26, 27, 30A(5), 31, 32, 34(2)(a); Civil Liability Act 2002 s 13A; Motor Vehicle (Third Party Insurance) Act 1943 ss 3EA, 3FB

lives: chloe c074 (2034): a used car, licensed with compulsory third party insurance -- what that cover means if she is catastrophically injured (the CISS, or a common-law claim)
